name: Zalatárnok (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalatárnok: a quartered green and yellow shield with a book, a tower, a church and a wavy stripe, above a scroll inscribed ZALATÁRNOK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
